description: Core rules shared by the eight todo-* command skills: the TODO.md task tree (compact task format, complexity levels, IDs, lanes), git flow with a no-git fallback, invariants I1-I10, Definition of Done and hard guardrails. Load it before any todo-* command or when editing an Active Backlog TODO.md. Run alone as /todo it only lists the commands and runs a read-only invariant check.
